Ref: IRDA/LIFE/Andhra Pradesh & Tamilnadu Floods/2018-19 2ath December,2018
To Chairman/CEOs of Life Insurers.
As a result of the Cyclones in the states of Andhra Pradesh (Phethai Cyclone) and Tamil
Nadu (Gaja cyclone), there are reports of loss of human lives and loss of belongings in
these states. In order to extend every possible facilitation in quick and timely settlement of
life insurance claims, you are advised to take the following actions immediately:
